verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions (docs-2, docs-15, docs-20) provides CI/CD workflow support, but all evidence describes self-hosted runners you configure yourself, not platform-hosted runners requiring zero infrastructure management. The only mention of a 'managed environment' (gitea-docs-22) refers to hosted Gitea instances generally, not specifically to platform-provided CI/CD runners, and no evidence describes a hosted-runner-as-a-service offering.
